title: Monthly Equipment Reliability and PM Compliance Report
description: Tracks PM completion rates, equipment downtime events, calibration compliance, and out-of-service asset counts. Submitted to the Quality Committee on the 5th of each month.

title: Monthly Healthcare-Associated Infection Surveillance Report
description: Reports HAI rates by type (CLABSI, CAUTI, SSI, VAP) by ward, benchmarked against NABH targets. Triggers corrective action if rates exceed thresholds.

title: Quarterly Clinical Audit and Quality Metrics Summary
description: Aggregates results from all departmental clinical audits, incident trends, non-conformances, and corrective action completion rates. Presented to the Board of Governors.

title: Monthly Pharmacy Drug Utilization and Stock Report
description: Tracks drug consumption patterns, high-cost drug utilization, near-expiry stock, controlled substance reconciliation, and stock-out incidents. Submitted to the Drug & Therapeutics Committee.

title: Monthly Billing Reconciliation and Revenue Report
description: Reconciles billed revenue against collected payments, insurance claims outstanding, waivers granted, and billing correction activity. Reviewed by the Finance Committee on the 10th of each month.

title: Daily Bed Occupancy and Availability Report
description: Real-time and end-of-day snapshot of bed occupancy by ward, type, and speciality. Used for daily bed management meetings and capacity planning. Sent to department heads and senior management at 7 AM and 7 PM.
